source.author: R. B. Robinson and C. Driver
source.note: The NTRS download carries a 436-byte wrapper before %PDF; the stripped copy (bytes 437 onward) is the file read.
source.declared_accuracy_source: RM L51K16a, PDF p. 6 (printed 5): estimated errors in the force data CL +/-0.005, CD +/-0.001, Cm +/-0.001; wing angle of attack +/-0.1 deg

figure.title: Aerodynamic characteristics in pitch of the various wing-body configurations. (e) Λ = 47°; t/c = 0.09.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, common to the three plots of the page and labelled only under the bottom (angle-of-attack) plot: -.2 at the left frame line, 0 at the heavy axis line, .8 at the right frame line, labels every 0.1. On the graph paper the heavy vertical lines fall every 0.05 C_L (about 71.3 px on this page), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.025), fine lines every 0.005 (about 7.1 px). The C_L = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D, scale on the right of the middle plot: labels 0, .04, .08, .12, .16, .20. The heavy horizontal lines fall every 0.02 C_D (about 71.4 px; the labels sit on every second one), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.01), fine lines every 0.002 (about 7.1 px). The C_D = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.content_note: Middle plot of the page only (C_D against C_L). One faired curve with 8 hollow circles (radius about 13 px), all single: no doubled outline or second circle seen. Several circles (e.g. 3, 6, 7, 8) show a faint speck near the centre (a pin prick or dirt, not a drawn centre dot; the ring fit ignores it). Circle 2 has its left edge about 2 px from the heavy C_L = 0 axis line and the 0.03 C_D line across it near the centre, with the faired curve through it; circle 5 has the heavy 0.06 C_D line across its lower half; circle 7 has the heavy 0.50 C_L line through it left of centre; circle 8 has its right edge on the heavy 0.60 C_L line and its bottom edge on the 0.15 C_D line. The scan is slightly rotated (horizontal lines about 6 px lower at the right frame than at the left) and shows 1-px steps of the grid lines along vertical seams (e.g. near x 590 and 740).

calibration.x_definition: C_L: vertical heavy and medium grid lines of the graph paper, every 0.025 from the left frame line (-0.20) to the right frame line (0.80).
calibration.y_definition: C_D: horizontal heavy and medium grid lines, every 0.01 from the heavy C_D = 0 line (labelled 0) to the 0.20 line (labelled .20).

series.symbol: hollow circle without centre dot, radius about 13 px
